name: Extort My Heart
source:
After a strange error message appears on your desktop you end up in a chatroom created by a woman who goes by 'Nova.' Due to your lack of funds and her own boredom you're now locked into a deal where you have to keep her entertained in order to keep your secrets from getting revealed!

[From [url=https://corvidscauldron.itch.io/extort-my-heart-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你的桌面上出现奇怪的错误消息后，你最终会进入一个由“Nova”女士创建的聊天室。由于你缺乏资金和她自己的无聊，你现在陷入了一项交易，你必须让她开心，以防止你的秘密被泄露！

[来自[url=https://corvidscauldron.itch.io/extort-my-heart-demo]itch.io[/url]]
